verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is a SaaS payments platform that processes merchant and customer data and advertises AI-driven optimization, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no data-usage policy, training opt-out, or privacy control addressing AI model training. The AI-related material covers only the MCP server, agentic commerce, and AI-driven payment optimization, none of which is about this story.
